propositions: Provider-prefixed model_ref strings (e.g. 'anthropic:claude-opus-4-8', 'openai:gpt-5.4') passed to genai_prices.calc_price raise LookupError because genai-prices expects bare model ids and the LookupError is caught and silently converted to unpriced.

The asymmetry in pricing results (Bedrock prices correctly, Anthropic and OpenAI return unpriced) silently biases provider cost comparisons in CI job summaries, making unpriceable providers appear absent rather than revealing id resolution failures.

Usage log rows for Anthropic and OpenAI models stored with provider prefixes are dropped from cost totals without visible warning, causing 'est. cost excludes N unpriced calls' output on runs where all models are known to genai-prices.

Model id translation must be decided by registry membership (KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES) rather than prefix matching or string splitting, because naive splitting breaks versioned AWS Bedrock ids like 'anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0'.
Genuinely unknown models must remain tolerated as best-effort unpriced rows without breaking summarize, but must be distinguishable in output from mis-formatted provider-qualified ids.
